record.paper_title: Open problems on compact constant mean curvature surfaces with boundary
record.original_question: Let Ω be a bounded convex domain. Give conditions guaranteeing that a constant-mean-curvature graph over Ω with planar boundary is itself convex.

evidence.quote: Problem 4.3. Let Ω be a bounded convex domain. Give conditions that assure the convexity of a cmc graph on Ω and with planar boundary.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be a bounded convex domain, and let $H \in \mathbb{R}$ be a constant. A constant-mean-curvature (CMC) graph over $\Omega$ with planar boundary is the graph $\Sigma = \{(x,y,u(x,y)) : (x,y) \in \overline{\Omega}\} \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ of a function $u \in C^2(\Omega) \cap C^0(\overline{\Omega})$ satisfying
$$\operatorname{div}\!\left(\frac{\nabla u}{\sqrt{1+|\nabla u|^2}}\right) = 2H \quad \text{in } \Omega, \qquad u\big|_{\partial\Omega} = 0,$$
so that $\partial \Sigma = \partial \Omega \subset \{z=0\}$. The surface $\Sigma$ is said to be convex if it bounds (together with $\overline{\Omega}$) a convex region of $\mathbb{R}^3$, equivalently, if its second fundamental form is positive semidefinite everywhere.

Problem: Find geometric or analytic conditions on $\Omega$ and $H$ (for instance, conditions on the curvature of $\partial\Omega$, the size of $\Omega$ relative to $1/|H|$, or on the height $\sup_{\Omega} |u|$) that guarantee that every such CMC graph $\Sigma$ over $\Omega$ with planar boundary $\partial\Omega$ is convex.
artifact.status_search_result: Partial results are known: level curves of a CMC graph over a bounded convex domain with planar boundary are convex above a sufficient height, and analogous convexity theorems hold for spacelike CMC graphs in Lorentz–Minkowski space. However, a general sharp criterion ensuring convexity of the CMC graph itself over an arbitrary bounded convex planar domain remains open.

status_evidence.title: Level curves of constant mean curvature graphs over convex domains
status_evidence.snippet: Level curves are convex provided their height with respect to the boundary plane is sufficiently large.
status_evidence.claim: Partial convexity result for level curves of CMC graphs over convex domains.

status_evidence.title: Convexity of the solutions to the constant mean curvature spacelike surface equation in the Lorentz–Minkowski space
status_evidence.snippet: A spacelike graph of constant mean curvature over a bounded domain with pseudoelliptic boundary is strictly convex.
status_evidence.claim: Convexity is established in the Lorentzian analogue but not fully in the Euclidean CMC case.
